question.problem:
Let $X$ and $Y$ be two continuous random variables with the joint probability density function

$$
f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{8}{3}{x}^{3}y, & 0\le x\le 1,\,1\le y\le 2, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Find the expression for the marginal PDF ${f}_{Y}(y).$
question.worked_solution:
If $X$ and $Y$ are two continuous random variables with joint probability density function $f(x,y),$ then the marginal density functions for $X$ and $Y$ are

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X}(x)={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }f(x,y)\,\text{d}y,\,{f}_{Y}(y)={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }f(x,y)\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

In our case, the marginal density function of $Y$ for $1\le y\le 2$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y}(y) & ={\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{8}{3}{x}^{3}y\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{8}{3}y{[\frac{1}{4}{x}^{4}]}_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =\frac{2}{3}y[{x}^{4}]_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =\frac{2}{3}y({1}^{4}-0) \\  & =\frac{2}{3}y.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the full expression for ${f}_{Y}(y)$ is given by

$$
{f}_{Y}(y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{3}y, & 1\le y\le 2, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$
